title: Neighbourhood social network
summary: A private network for your street or suburb: lost pets, recommendations, local news.
whyTempting: People want local community and trusted local information.
whyItFails: Negativity spiral. Content skews to complaints, crime fears and disputes. Moderation burden. Hyper-local disputes are hard and legally risky to moderate. Facebook Groups exist. Local Facebook groups already capture most of this.
whatWouldChange: A narrow utility wedge (e.g. local services or council issues) rather than a general feed.

attempts.notes: Hyperlocal neighbourhood news; shut by NBC in 2013, relaunched by Comcast, then acquired and closed by Nextdoor.
Long-running criticism over racial profiling and a 'snitch app' reputation; cut 25% of staff in 2023.

reasons.detail: Negativity spiral: Content skews to complaints, crime fears and disputes.
Moderation burden: Hyper-local disputes are hard and legally risky to moderate.
Facebook Groups exist: Local Facebook groups already capture most of this.
